findings.evidence: research/ultimate/run.cjs invokes lab.register(protocol) and writes evidence/ultimate/research.sqlite, protocol.json and report.json
findings.action: Do not use runner for exact diagnostic reproduction; use pure runStudy with retained inputs, no registration and separate outputs.

findings.message: 119.75USD is not the complete stock/ETF fishing net. 3 hypotheses x 3 exits x 2 symbols were explored.

The retained report exports funded aggregates, but no funded campaign list or financed daily curve. dailyUnitReturns belongs to overlapping unit-risk opportunities; it is not substitute account evidence.

Exporting unchanged financed campaigns and decomposing their existing result is descriptive reproduction. Removing symbols, changing timing filters, size, cap or re-entry rules creates new policy variants even without model fitting.

Quant measurement registration requires exact C0/RIDGE/SVR schema,3 slots and at most6. Ultimate reserves9*universe slots. Do not register a cap/asset ablation as a fixed model comparison or reset a journal.
With initial equity=hard cap=20000, min(current equity,initial equity) and min(current equity,cap) are identical. A comparison must not manufacture a distinct reinvestment policy from these labels.

findings.inference: Two symbols with12% maximum allocation each imply about24% combined entry-notional headroom at the sizing equity; this is not observed mean exposure. Measure actual exposure and cash time from financed marks.

reproduction_acceptance: Retained dataset, protocol and computation source identities are recorded.
Pure replay reproduces full stable report (excluding generatedAt) before trusting new rows.
Campaign count31 and total net119.74999999999952 reconcile within declared float tolerance.
Sum per-symbol dollars and each exclusive entry-window cohort reconcile to the SAME portfolio dollars.
Daily portfolio PnL sums to terminal net; day-linked equity starts20000 and ends20119.75 with no resets.
Product daily(1+portfolio return) equals terminal equity ratio within declared tolerance.
No per-asset return aggregation with incompatible capital denominators.
Opening first90minutes and closing final90minutes use actual retained session boundaries; at most one bucket per trade, with an explicit overlap bucket if session length permits overlap.
Cohort attribution uses entry time and is labeled separately from PnL occurring in a time-of-day window.
Open terminal marks and costs are retained; no synthetic end liquidation.

next_study.scope: Retrospective exploration is allowed with present bars, but cannot authorize profitability6 or be relabeled a fresh final test.
next_study.principle: Compare one candidate to the frozen native portfolio with same capital, cost assumptions, observations and event timeline; Ridge requires its authentic frozen model and causal training provenance.
next_study.budget: Declare the baseline/reproduction vs new variant accounting and bind to existing cumulative history before any new candidate run; no reservation made in this review.
forbidden_shortcuts: Drop a losing ETF after observing this period and call the same period out of sample.
Increase exposure and call dollar profit growth strategy alpha.
Accept individual rows of unit-curve metrics as financed portfolio performance.
Treat100 causal sessions as a universal mathematical requirement for exploratory diagnostics.
Treat a small genuinely unseen period as sufficient proof of profit merely because it is new.

new_material_finding.frozen_replay_rule: CLOSED_CHANNEL target first.t+72h; fills at first available later bar when deadline passes
new_material_finding.runtime_rule: deadlineFor uses latest applicable calendar session and min(target,session.close-10min)

recommended_single_next_study.purpose: Correct calendar feasibility in the financed replay using existing runtime deadline semantics, preserving the frozen fold selection map.
recommended_single_next_study.baseline: Exact reproduced original portfolio with119.75USD and31campaigns, retained unchanged.
recommended_single_next_study.changed_dimension_only: Calendar-aware maximum-holding deadline for CLOSED_CHANNEL execution.
recommended_single_next_study.execution_requirement: Replay all control common opportunities routed by the fixed fold map, including prior SYMBOL_BUSY skips. Carry cash, inventory, partial-exit changes and sizing forward.
recommended_single_next_study.do_not: Re-evaluate and select nine policy variants, replay only31 old fills, subtract90.47USD, or scale PnL by quantity ratios.
recommended_single_next_study.clock_requirement: Document whether runtime deadline is anchored at decision/creation time or modeled fill time. Do not silently use a future fill to calculate a decision available earlier.
recommended_single_next_study.bar_resolution: Execute with the established observed-bar price/availability convention. Missing executable bars remain incidents; never fill retrospectively at a fabricated deadline price.
recommended_single_next_study.economic_costs: External economic costs remain unknown unless provided, so modeled PnL must not be called complete economic profit.
recommended_single_next_study.acceptance: Correctness and attributed change only; no financial promotion and no new out-of-sample label.

budget_registration.method: Append-only continuation record bound before execution to original protocol, dataset, candidate source, fold map, existing exported registry and available Quant journal identity.
budget_registration.restriction: Do not claim that the legacy Ultimate ledger became19 or that a new six-slot budget resets prior attempts. Retain distinct counting units and every outcome.
